components.summary: Accumulated student failure patterns on SpreadsheetBench xlsx tasks and the interventions that fix them: skill-first, in-place edit, worked examples as spec, literal values, coordinate discipline, assertion verification, mechanical ground truth, loop and budget discipline.

xlsx manipulation workflow and pitfall catalog: explore-first data discovery, literal values over formulas, data_only reads, key normalization, target-range hygiene. Reference for diagnosing which workflow step the student got wrong.

Diff input vs output workbook inside the answer range and report every pre-filled literal cell the output changed. Deploy before the student finishes when no input-output comparison appears in the trajectory.

Mechanical health check of the deliverable's answer range: empty range, formula strings, numbers-as-text, error literals, degenerate constant fills. Deploy after the output workbook exists, before finishing.
